definitions.explanation: Full of energy and activity. Used to describe people who are energetic, discussions that are lively, or activities and phenomena that are vigorous and ongoing.

examples.japanese: {活発|かっぱつ}な{議論|ぎろん}が{行|おこな}われた。
{彼女|かのじょ}は{子供|こども}の{頃|ころ}から{活発|かっぱつ}な{性格|せいかく}だった。
examples.english: She has had an energetic personality since childhood.

examples.japanese: {火山|かざん}{活動|かつどう}が{活発|かっぱつ}になり、{周辺|しゅうへん}{住民|じゅうみん}に{避難|ひなん}{勧告|かんこく}が{出|だ}された。
examples.english: Volcanic activity became vigorous, and an evacuation advisory was issued to nearby residents.

notes:
USAGE:
{活発|かっぱつ} describes energetic, vigorous activity. It can modify people (an energetic child), abstract activities (a lively debate), or natural phenomena (vigorous volcanic activity). Compare with {元気|げんき} (healthy, energetic), which focuses on personal well-being, while {活発|かっぱつ} emphasizes dynamic activity and can apply to non-human subjects.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {活発|かっぱつ}な{議論|ぎろん}: lively discussion
- {活発|かっぱつ}な{子|こ}: an active/energetic child
- {活発|かっぱつ}に{活動|かつどう}する: to be actively involved
- {活発|かっぱつ}な{火山|かざん}{活動|かつどう}: vigorous volcanic activity
- {活発|かっぱつ}な{取引|とりひき}: brisk trading
